description: EXPERIMENTAL (undocumented QE DOM: removeVideoTrack/removeAudioTrack). Delete a video or audio track from the active sequence through QE and verify that exactly that track was removed (the remaining tracks keep their clips, custom names and lock/mute state in order). Refuses a track that still holds clips unless force is true.

force.description: Also delete a track that holds clips, removing those clips (default: false)

track_index.description: Index of the track to delete (0-based)

name: delete_track

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true; on failure, diagnostic detail when the tool provides it.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Delete Track
